Hi Aisha —

Thanks for sending this over and for the attachments. Quick notes and next steps from our side:

1) Required fields for vendor master (we already captured from your email):
   - Legal name, Tax ID, Registered address, AP contact details
   - Beneficial ownership / UBO declaration (if not on file for US entities we sometimes request review)

2) PO routing:
   - We support two primary channels: ERP integration (preferred for recurring POs) or email-based PO delivery to vendor-po@terraquill.io.
   - For initial setup we'll route POs to vendor-po@terraquill.io and copy AP (marc.conway@terraquill.io). After the first 3 POs we'll transition to ERP if you provide EDI/ERP endpoint.

3) Banking info: we'll ingest the bank spreadsheet into a secure vault and our AP team will validate a micro-deposit test if needed.

Can you confirm: (a) the vendor remit email to receive POs, (b) whether TerraQuill needs PO numbers prefixed (e.g., RWD-), and (c) whether Marc is the authorized signer for invoices?

I've attached our onboarding checklist and a simple PO contact matrix to this thread for your review.

Thanks — I'll coordinate with Marissa on the legal/UBO ask and with Kimberly for the AP ingestion window.

Regards,
